saw_lines: Parents buy toys for a birthday or a rainy afternoon, and they want other parents to vouch first.
So the vouch has to sit in the first line of the ad, before the buyer leaves for a competitor.
Your 28 copy ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure like review count or orders shipped and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: None of your 28 copy ads shows a proof number, so a first-time parent has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

3 of your 28 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so they read like a company pitch when parents want another parent’s voice. Whitelist them from the creator account and cut three variations of each.

Your 28 copy ads open with 17 different stories, and the biggest leads only 3 ads, so the account has no clear direction. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch only from them, three ads each.

12 of your ads have run 60 days or more, so they already work, yet none has a variation next to it. Build three more versions of the oldest winner, changing only the opening line and keeping the product shot.

ads_1: Creator-led video tests on your two best openers, each with a proof number
